name: source-business-knowledge
description: Generate structured, business-only Markdown knowledge from source repositories; keep technical evidence in separate analysis records.

interface.shortDescription: Turn source code into business knowledge Markdown
interface.longDescription: Explain system purpose, modules, workflows, rules and exceptions in business-only Markdown with meaningful sections and prose. Keep source evidence private in analysis records.
defaultPrompt: 使用 source-business-knowledge 分析指定仓库，输出有业务小节和说明段落的纯业务知识 Markdown；正文不含代码、实现细节或源码引用，调查证据另存 analysis/。
